private_lines.Meriem: You teach at a primary school in Tunis, and your days are lesson plans and marking. You live alone in a flat in Tunis and usually get home by late afternoon.
private_lines.Anis: You run a small grocery shop in a Tunis neighbourhood, opening early and closing in the evening. You live in a house in Tunis with your wife, and you spend afternoons at the food bank when you can.
private_lines.Wassim: You work as an IT technician for a company in Tunis, mostly fixing office computers and networks. You live with your parents in their flat in Tunis, and you go to the gym a few evenings a week.
private_lines.Olfa: You work as a clerk at the municipality in Tunis, handling permits and records. You live alone in an apartment in Tunis, and in the evenings you cook and read.
